key_naming: sb = StatsBomb side of the LOCAL external leg, wy = Wyscout/Pappalardo side, as one _-separated part of a key that concerns one provider, a convention most keys of the public run do not need; no key of this file, of results.json or of the LOCAL file of the external leg contains statsbomb, pappalardo or wyscout in any letter case or starts with SB_ (E-11 PIPELINE section 0, key names)
counted_by_root_rule: the root runs one committed structure-only script over the five leagues (and sb_reader.folder_manifest over the three local folders whose digest is null) after the audit and before the registration commit; for every key of counted_by_root_before_registration that is not in counted_by_root_assumption_pins, a null is filled, a value that differs from the draft is replaced and the difference is stated in the registration commit and in REVIEW-RECORD.md; these keys are the only edits to this file after the audit, and the file is then registered byte for byte
counted_by_root_assumption_rule: the frozen text depends on these values (preregistration 3 states that the leagues hold no period outside periods and phase 2 stops when the period filter drops a row, shot_frame raises on a shot row with a null body part, preregistration 5.4 states that the two clauses of opp_half_defensive_actions do not overlap, phase 2 stops on a shot-family disagreement), so the same script counts them and they are never edited: a count that differs from this file's value is not written; registration stops, and the draft returns to a revision that freezes a rule for those rows (for example, a shot without exactly one body part left out of the model domain and counted), then to an audit
root_rulings_rule: ROOT-DECISIONS 2.10 (18 October 2026) ruled every question the audit's revision put to the root (REVIEW-RECORD, "For a root ruling"); W1 to W9 are applied in this file, preregistration.md and PIPELINE.md, and W10 requires each revision to be audited before E-09 is called READY; W2, as extended on 18 October 2026, rules the open-play design for all three shot candidates, and ROOT 2.2's parentheses for shot_volume and shot_location_value are amended to match (the second in commit 58be68b); no question waits for a root ruling
minutes_rule: per player-match min(lineups minutes, regulation_minutes_cap), summed over the player's league matches: E-11's minutes_regulation on the Wyscout side, imported unchanged
share_floor_counts: box_shot_share denominator rows: every neutral shot row of the player that survives the period filter, in the season or in the match set
split_rule: a match is in match set h (0 or 1) when the position of its game_id among the league's sorted unique game_ids of actions.parquet is h modulo 2
position_indexing: league_position, world_position, scenario_position and replicate are 0-based indices into leagues, synthetic_worlds, synthetic_instrument_scenarios and range(selfcheck_replicates); on the external leg league_position is the 0-based index into sb_folders (sb_leg_config_rule)
half_low_rule: spearman_brown(tanh(atanh(r_half) - interval_z / sqrt(n - 2 - g))), g the number of position groups kept in R; defined when r_half is finite, |r_half| < 1 and n - 2 - g >= 1, else the league is INCONCLUSIVE
within_position_rule: half_low_rule with g = 1, on the uncentred values of one position's players in R
team_and_position_centring: reported only: within each match set, each value of R minus the mean over R of the players with the same player_team (player_team_rule) and broad position; reliability_estimate with that cell as the group, so g is the number of cells; never gating
context_limit_rule: a position is a context limit of a candidate when, in at least context_limit_leagues of the five leagues, its within-position lower bound is below reliability_band or is not computed (fewer than within_position_report_minimum players, or undefined); reported, never gating
position_centring_set: A, by broad position, value and column alike
baseline_tie_rule: every column whose correlation equals baseline_r is listed in closest_baselines, in battery order
top_k_tied_statement: The twelfth and thirteenth values are tied, so the twelve largest values do not name a set of players and no survivor count exists.
frozen_correlation_source_hash_rule: galactico.validation.digests.lf_sha256_text(inspect.getsource(run_replication._safe_abs_corr)); its three-pair minimum and its 1e-12 are part of the pinned source, not config values; degenerate_sd still guards first

zones.phrase: starting in the penalty area as the second provider draws it

zone_use: opponent_half and penalty_area are read by the four public candidates; penalty_area_sb (E-11's quotients 102/120, 18/80 and 62/80, bounds inclusive) is read only by the external leg's box spec in candidate_sb.py

scalings.per action in the denominator set: per {singular noun of the denominator clause}

describe_refusals: CandidateSpec refuses a shape describe() cannot word: a clause with both types and flags, a clause with more than one type, subtype or flag, numerator clauses with different zones, a denominator of more than one clause, a denominator type without a singular noun, a noun missing from describe_nouns
duel_or_interception_rule: the two numerator clauses of opp_half_defensive_actions with the zone removed, each row once, per 90 minutes

candidates.display_name: Open-play shots per 90 (no penalties, no direct free kicks)

claim.construct: How often the player shoots in open play. Not that the shots are good ones.
claim.observable_implication: A player who shoots more in one match set shoots more in the other, among players of the same broad position.
claim.negative_control: Must not be a near-copy of touch volume or of mean field position.
claim.incremental_claim: None. This is the house baseline column itself, proposed under its own name, as pass completion was after E-03; its own column is removed from its battery and from no other.

candidates.e11_definition: aggregated_player_quantities.shot_volume: open_play_shots / minutes_regulation x 90, open_play_shot = Wyscout type shot

candidates.display_name: Location-only conversion value of open-play shots from the opponent half per 90 (not provider xG)
candidates.sentence: sum of location-only conversion value over shots starting in the opponent half, per 90 minutes

claim.construct: Shot volume weighted by where the shots came from; shot volume is a declared component. Not the opportunity as the shooter met it: defenders, goalkeeper, pressure and shot type are not in the number.
claim.observable_implication: Two players with equal shot volume separate if one shoots from closer and more central positions.
claim.negative_control: Must not be a near-copy of shot_volume, at the frozen baseline_ceiling.
claim.incremental_claim: The location weighting separates players that counting does not. ROOT 2.2 requires it to show that or be rejected as redundant (redundancy_closes_first).

candidates.e11_definition: not graded by E-11 (its model is E-09's)

candidates.display_name: Share of open-play shots starting in the provider-drawn penalty area
candidates.sentence: count over shots starting in the penalty area, per shot
candidates.scaling: per action in the denominator set

claim.construct: Where the player's shots originate. Not a preference: the share includes deployment and team-mates.
claim.observable_implication: A player whose shots come from inside the area in one match set shows the same in the other, among players of his position.
claim.negative_control: Must not be a near-copy of mean field position or of shot volume.
claim.incremental_claim: None beyond location. It is the model-free location descriptor, so the location half of shot_profile is tested even if the conversion model is not accepted.

candidates.e11_definition: not graded by E-11 at the player level (E-11 preregistration, what it cannot show)

candidates.display_name: Opponent-half ground defending duels and interception-flagged events per 90
candidates.sentence: count over ground defending duel records or interception-flagged events, starting in the opponent half, per 90 minutes

claim.construct: How often the player is recorded contesting or cutting out the ball in the opponent half. Not a record of pressing, of winning the ball or of defending ability.
claim.observable_implication: Repeatable between match sets among players of the same position, and not reducible to how much the player is in that half at all.
claim.negative_control: Must not be a near-copy of ground defending duels and interceptions over the whole pitch, of on-ball presence in the opponent half, or of mean field position.
claim.incremental_claim: Location of defensive activity, separate from its amount.

candidates.e11_definition: aggregated_player_quantities.opp_half_defensive_actions: opp_half_duel_or_interception / minutes_regulation x 90, a ground defending duel or an interception-flagged row with a finite start x above 0.5 and no sentinel start

model_family: unpenalised logistic regression, iteratively reweighted least squares, NumPy
model_domain: neutral type shot, start in zone opponent_half (start_x > 0.50 strictly, not a location sentinel)
gate_s_fit_rule: every model of gate_s_fit_models, and the instrument, converged in every fold; M0 is the training goal rate and is not fitted; on the public run a challenger that did not converge in every fold is not selectable and fails nothing, so there the rule equals convergence of every model of gate_s_fit_models in every fold; on the external leg the instrument is fixed by the public selection, and its non-convergence in any fold fails S-fit
instrument_inconclusive_rule: S-count fails: no fit, select_instrument is not called, selection, fits, leagues, pooled and shot values are null, failed_gates is [S_count], reason S_COUNT; S-count passes and S-fit fails: the fits and the R and L statistics are reported, their gates are not evaluated (passed null), failed_gates is [S_fit], reason S_FIT; S_COUNT precedes S_FIT; otherwise every failed R and L gate is listed
calibration_fit_failure: a calibration slope or intercept fit that does not converge is None, and None fails its gate in that league
bootstrap_rule: np.random.default_rng([seed, league_position]).multinomial(n_matches, [1/n_matches] * n_matches, size=bootstrap_replicates), n_matches the number of unique game_ids in the held-out league's in-domain shot frame, in sorted game_id order; statistics recomputed from per-match sums; pooled statistics add the five leagues' resampled sums, replicate by replicate
gate_r2_gain: relative: (LL_MD - LL_instrument) / LL_MD on the pooled out-of-league predictions
auroc_rule: pooled over the concatenated out-of-league predictions of the five leagues; average ranks for ties
ece_binning_rule: sort by probability (stable); c_0 = 0, c_ece_bins = n; for k = 1..ece_bins-1, c_k is the smallest i with i >= ceil(k*n/ece_bins), i < n and p[i] != p[i-1], else n; bins are [c_(k-1), c_k); empty bins are dropped; rows with equal probability are never split between bins
mce_rule: largest absolute gap between mean probability and observed rate over the bins
rows_outside_periods_rule: rows of the league's neutral actions frame, as load_public returns it, whose period is not in periods; an assumption pin (counted_by_root_assumption_pins): preregistration 3 states that the leagues hold no other period, and phase 2 stops when the period filter drops a row
structure_identity: per league shot_rows = in_domain_shot_rows + behind_halfway_shot_rows + sentinel_start_shot_rows: a sentinel start is either location_sentinels pair; behind_halfway counts non-sentinel shot rows with start_x <= 0.50; in_domain counts non-sentinel shot rows with start_x > 0.50; asserted in phase 2
league_not_computed_precedence: where too_few_evaluable_leagues and instrument_not_accepted both apply to a league of shot_location_value, instrument_not_accepted is recorded, as rows 1 and 2 of the candidate rule precede row 3

registry_common.not_run_statement: E-09 is registered and not run. No candidate statistic and no estimate of the conversion model has been computed.

registry_candidate.scope: Outfield players with at least the frozen regulation minutes in the 2017/18 first divisions of Spain, England, Italy, Germany and France, public Wyscout event data (Pappalardo et al. 2019), and for the share candidate players who also reach the frozen season and match-set shot counts; player-season values; reliability within broad position, each league separately; positions listed under context_limits in results.json are those where reliability within the position alone was not shown, reported beside the claim.
registry_candidate.non_claim: A descriptor of how often or where a player's recorded events occur, repeatable within one season among players of the same broad position. It does not say how well a player shoots or defends, it is not comparable across leagues or seasons, and the data were seen before the protocol was written, so the result is exploratory.

registry_instrument.scope: Open-play shots starting in the opponent half in the 2017/18 first divisions of Spain, England, Italy, Germany and France, public Wyscout event data (Pappalardo et al. 2019); each league predicted by a model estimated on the other four.
registry_instrument.non_claim: A location-only model of whether a shot became a goal, fitted out of league for research. It is not the provider's xG, says nothing about finishing or about a single shot, and enters no dated decision. The data were seen before the protocol was written, so the result is exploratory.

ESTABLISHED_NUMBER.statement: Repeatable between the two match sets of one season among players of the same broad position: in at least four of the five leagues it passed the frozen rule at the number threshold, each such league with a reliability lower bound at or above that threshold and no declared baseline statistic correlated with it above the ceiling. This experiment itself promotes nothing: a statistic is shown beside players only after a separate promotion with its own decision record.

ESTABLISHED_BAND.statement: Repeatable between the two match sets of one season among players of the same broad position: in at least four of the five leagues it passed the frozen rule, with a reliability lower bound at or above the band threshold and not a near-copy of any declared baseline statistic, and in fewer than four it passed at the number threshold. A band, never a point value. This experiment itself promotes nothing: a statistic is shown beside players only after a separate promotion with its own decision record.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.statement: Compared and not established. Closed as redundant by the frozen rule: in at least one league where it was evaluated, a declared baseline statistic correlated with it above the ceiling declared before the test.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CONFOUNDED.statement: Compared and not established. Rejected in more than half of the leagues where it was evaluated, and closed as confounded: the nuisance variables declared for it, taken together, explained more of its variance than the ceiling declared before the test allows, the reason the frozen closure rule selects.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNRELIABLE.statement: Compared and not established. Rejected in more than half of the leagues where it was evaluated, and closed as not repeatable: between the two match sets of a season, among players of the same broad position, its reliability lower bound fell below the band threshold, the reason the frozen closure rule selects.

INCONCLUSIVE_INSTRUMENT.statement: Not evaluated as a candidate: the location-only conversion model it depends on was judged and did not meet its frozen out-of-league criteria. Nothing was compared at the candidate level.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_MIXED.statement: Compared and not established. It passed in fewer leagues than the frozen rule needs and was rejected in no more than half of the leagues where it was evaluated.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: A frozen sample or data gate was not met in too many leagues, or the conversion model it depends on was not judged. Nothing was compared at the candidate level.

ACCEPTED.statement: Fitted out of league on the public event data of five leagues, the location-only conversion model met every frozen criterion on relative value within a league, on level and on calibration across value bins.

ACCEPTED_WITHIN_LEAGUE.statement: Fitted out of league on the public event data of five leagues, the location-only conversion model met every frozen criterion on relative value within a league and failed at least one on level or on calibration across value bins. Its values carry no goal unit and are never compared across leagues.

NOT_ESTABLISHED.statement: Fitted out of league, the location-only conversion model failed at least one frozen criterion on relative value within a league. No candidate that depends on it was evaluated.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: A frozen sample gate of the model was not met, or a required model estimation did not converge. The model was not judged.

tested_not_promoted_edit.rule: a declared hand edit tied to the token by a test, not a registry_move (rule V6 forbids a move on an ESTABLISHED outcome): the results commit writes TESTED_NOT_PROMOTED = {candidate id: (headline, detail)} in galactico/profiles/build.py whatever the tokens, empty when no candidate is established, with headline and detail from player_lab_text[token]

player_lab_counts_after_run: proposed = shipped constructs + |REJECTED| + |RESEARCH_ONLY| + |TESTED_NOT_PROMOTED| + |UNTESTED| = 13 under every assignment of the eight candidate tokens to the four candidates; tested = proposed - |UNTESTED|; surviving = shipped constructs = 5

display_name_edit.rule: the results commit writes DISPLAY_NAMES = {candidate id: display_name of candidates} in galactico/profiles/build.py for every candidate it enters in REJECTED, RESEARCH_ONLY or TESTED_NOT_PROMOTED; galactico/api/player_lab.py serves that name as the label and falls back to the id rule only for ids it does not hold

ESTABLISHED_NUMBER.headline: Tested and established, not promoted in this release
ESTABLISHED_NUMBER.detail: Repeatable between two sets of a season's matches among players of the same broad position, and not a near-copy of a declared baseline statistic in the leagues where it passed. It is not promoted and is not shown beside players in this release.

ESTABLISHED_BAND.headline: Tested and established with limits, not promoted in this release
ESTABLISHED_BAND.detail: Repeatable between two sets of a season's matches among players of the same broad position: it passed at the band threshold in enough leagues and at the number threshold in too few, and was not a near-copy of a declared baseline statistic in the leagues where it passed. A band, never a point value; it is not promoted and is not shown beside players in this release.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.headline: Too similar to {baseline}
NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.headline_tied: Too similar to declared baseline statistics
NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.detail: Correlated with a declared baseline statistic above the ceiling declared before the test, in the leagues where the frozen rule closed it. The analysis names the statistic and the leagues.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CONFOUNDED.headline: Mostly explained by {nuisance}
NOT_ESTABLISHED_CONFOUNDED.detail: The variables declared before the test as ones it must not be measuring, taken together, explained more of its variance than the ceiling allows; that was the reason the frozen rule closed it.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNRELIABLE.headline: Not repeatable between two sets of a season's matches within a position
NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNRELIABLE.detail: Among players of the same broad position, its values in the odd- and even-numbered matches of the season did not agree closely enough; that was the reason the frozen rule closed it.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_MIXED.headline: Survived in too few leagues
NOT_ESTABLISHED_MIXED.detail: It passed the frozen rule in some leagues and not in enough of them, and was rejected in no more than half.

planning_after_run.research_sentence: E-09 held four player statistics and a location-only shot conversion model to frozen criteria on public event data; each verdict says whether its subject was judged or left untested. That is not validity and not decision use, and no E-09 statistic is shown beside players.
planning_after_run.research_sentence_rule: written by the results commit into galactico/api/planning.py once any E-09 record's badge reads TESTED (status ESTABLISHED or NOT_ESTABLISHED); when a sentence written for another experiment is already in force, this sentence follows it; while no E-09 record reads TESTED the research sentence is not written (the shots entry is replaced whatever the tokens, shots_entry_rule)
planning_after_run.shots_entry_tested: No shot construct is shown. E-09 tested shot statistics on public event data; its verdicts are research labels, not validity or decision use, and none is promoted in this release.
planning_after_run.shots_entry_instrument_only: No shot construct is shown. E-09 tested a location-only conversion model on public event data, and its frozen gates left its shot statistics untested; none is promoted in this release.
planning_after_run.shots_entry_untested: No shot construct is shown. E-09 was run, and its frozen gates left its shot statistics untested; none is promoted in this release.
planning_after_run.shots_entry_rule: after the run, whatever the tokens, the results commit replaces the shots entry of NOT_MEASURED_EXTRA: with shots_entry_tested when shot_volume, shot_location_value or box_shot_share holds a token whose badge reads TESTED; else with shots_entry_instrument_only when shot_location_v1 holds one; else with shots_entry_untested; a clause about another experiment that is in force is kept after it

gap_matrix_edit.rule: under these instrument tokens only, the results commit adds to docs/LIVE-DATA-GAP-MATRIX.md, beside the xG / xA row, a note that the free corpus supports a location-only conversion model (shot_location_v1, PREDICTIVE) and no provider xG; under ACCEPTED_WITHIN_LEAGUE the note adds that its values are not compared across leagues; under NOT_ESTABLISHED or INCONCLUSIVE the matrix is not edited

baseline_fill_rule: the battery column that is a closest baseline in the most leagues closed as REDUNDANT; when two or more columns share that count, headline_tied

baseline_prose.mean_x: mean pitch position along its length
baseline_prose.mean_y: mean pitch position across its width
baseline_prose.opp_half_on_ball_per_90: passes and touches in the opponent half per ninety minutes
baseline_prose.duel_or_interception_per_90: ground defending duels and interceptions over the whole pitch

nuisance_prose.box_shot_share: on-ball action count and open-play shot volume
nuisance_prose.opp_half_defensive_actions: the share of the team's ground duel records that name no player

sb_folder_digest_rule: galactico.validation.sb_reader.folder_manifest, as E-11 section 2 computes it; La_Liga is E-11's registered digest
sb_minutes_rule: galactico.validation.sb_reader.read_team_sheets minutes_regulation (E-11 rule 2) with cap regulation_minutes_cap, regulation_periods sb_regulation_periods, goalkeeper_position sb_goalkeeper_position, dismissal_card_types_exclude sb_dismissal_card_types_exclude and spell_end_reason_contains sb_spell_end_reason_contains, summed over the season; is_goalkeeper, dismissed and permanent_off are not read
sb_event_row_rule: rows of sb_reader.read_events(scale=sb_location_scale) whose sb_player_id is not null, whose start_x and start_y are finite and whose period is in sb_regulation_periods; a row whose kind is not a key of sb_kind_type_map is dropped; a Shot row that is not open_play_shot by sb_flags_rule (its shot_type outside sb_open_play_shot_types) is dropped, never remapped
sb_flags_rule: on the leg, the open-play shot that keeps a Shot row and the interception flag are the open_play_shot and interception flags of galactico.validation.provider_inputs._statsbomb_flags(rows, e11_config, 'open_play') on the read_events rows, imported as a private member (one rule, never a second implementation, ROOT 2.9 Z3), e11_config being E-11's registered config.json, whose lf_sha256 equals e11_config_sha256, with provider_inputs.py pinned in source_hashes; sb_open_play_shot_types, sb_interception_kinds and sb_interception_pass_types restate E-11's keys of the same names, are asserted equal to them and are read by no branch
sb_frame_columns_rule: game_id, team_id, player_id from sb_game_id, sb_team_id, sb_player_id; event_id the provider's string, never cast; period by sb_period_labels; type by sb_kind_type_map; subtype null on every row (no leg clause or battery column reads it); start and end from read_events, an absent end NaN; success on a Pass row = not has_outcome (E-11's completed), null on every other row; goal = a Shot row whose outcome is in sb_goal_outcomes; counter_attack = play_pattern in sb_counter_attack_play_patterns; interception = the interception flag of sb_flags_rule (E-11's family: kind in sb_interception_kinds or a Pass whose pass_type is in sb_interception_pass_types, which matches the interception tag the public rule reads on passes); body_part by sb_body_part_map on Shot rows, null elsewhere; shot_family open_play on kept Shot rows, null elsewhere; location_sentinels are applied by Zone.mask as on the public run and the leg's sentinel-start shot rows are counted
sb_frame_refusal: a leg frame with no pass row, or with no row of any type other than shot, is refused before any statistic
sb_position_rule: the group of sb_position_groups with most regulation minutes over the player's season spells, each spell's regulation minutes taken from galactico.validation.sb_reader._spell (imported as a private member, never reimplemented) with cap regulation_minutes_cap and sb_regulation_periods; a tie goes to the group first in GK, DF, MD, FW order; a player whose group is GK is a goalkeeper and is excluded; a position name outside sb_position_groups stops the leg before any statistic
sb_battery_rule: compute_baselines on the leg's own frames built by sb_event_row_rule and sb_frame_columns_rule, with the leg's minutes; opp_half_on_ball_per_90 by opp_half_on_ball_rule on the same frames; the leg's battery columns are that provider's and are not compared with the public run's
sb_reader_pin_rule: lf_sha256(galactico/validation/sb_reader.py) equals the galactico/validation/sb_reader.py entry of source_hashes in experiments/preregistered/E-11-provider-agreement/acceptance.json, and equals this value
sb_code_pin_rule: --external, in both modes, refuses unless the source_hashes of the current files (the list of PIPELINE 7.2) equal provenance.source_hashes of the committed results.json, so the leg runs only on the code that produced the public results, fixed before any public outcome was known; a self-check stamp made after the results commit does not unlock it; the leg runs from a checkout whose pinned files are those of the results commit; a failed execution of the leg whose repair changes a pinned file ends the leg with no label, which analysis.md states, and is not a failed execution of the public run

sb_box_spec.sentence: count over shots starting in the penalty area as the second provider draws it, per shot
sb_box_spec.rule: defined in candidate_sb.py, never in CANDIDATES, which keeps its four keys

sb_leg_config_rule: the leg's view of this file, passed to every public function the leg calls (sb_leg_config): leagues becomes sb_folders, so league_position is the 0-based index into sb_folders for bootstrap_rule and the ece_null_seed draws; gate_s_count becomes sb_gate_s_count; gate_r1_leagues_required, gate_r3_leagues_required and gate_l_leagues_required become sb_gate_leagues_required; minimum_evaluable_leagues becomes sb_minimum_evaluable_leagues; context_limit_rule and every pooled statistic count over the four sb_folders, with context_limit_leagues unchanged; every other key is unchanged; candidate_verdict is not called on the leg, whose row and token are sb_verdict's

sb_statements.REPLICATED: On the second provider's earlier season of four leagues, the candidate passed the same frozen rule in at least three of them. Provider and season changed together.
sb_statements.NOT_REPLICATED: On the second provider's earlier season of four leagues, the candidate was rejected by the same frozen rule in at least three of them. Provider and season changed together.
sb_statements.MIXED: On the second provider's earlier season of four leagues, the candidate neither passed nor was rejected in three of them.
sb_statements.INCONCLUSIVE: Fewer than three of the second provider's four leagues were evaluated by the frozen rule: a frozen sample or data gate was not met in too many of them. Nothing was compared at the candidate level.
sb_statements.INSTRUMENT_NOT_ACCEPTED: The location-only conversion model, refitted on the second provider's four leagues, was not accepted there: it failed its frozen criteria, or a frozen sample or convergence gate was not met. The candidate was not evaluated.

sb_level_shift_rule: reported in the LOCAL file only, never a token: for each league the mean over A of the full-season value, computed for every league whose count gates passed (LeagueEvaluation.mean, null otherwise); m_sb and m_wy the unweighted means of the four sb_folders leagues and of their wy_league_of_sb_folder leagues; shift = (m_sb - m_wy) / m_wy; null when any of the eight league means is null or m_wy is 0; not computed for shot_location_value
selfcheck_seed_rule: worlds: np.random.default_rng([selfcheck_seed, world_position, replicate, league_position]); instrument scenarios: np.random.default_rng([selfcheck_seed, 100 + scenario_position, replicate, league_position]); generator sanity: np.random.default_rng([selfcheck_seed, 200, world_position]) for each world whose sanity bound needs draws (generator_sanity_rules.draws); resampling inside the self-check as in the real run (bootstrap_rule)
selfcheck_predicate: for each world or scenario and each subject it names: the number of replicates whose token is in expected is at least minimum_replicates_matching, the number whose token is in never is zero, where an also entry exists, the number whose token is in also.tokens is at least also.minimum_replicates_matching; where failing_gate is named, a replicate counts as matching only if that gate is among its failed gates; each league assertion holds in every replicate league; each generator sanity bound holds
selfcheck_smoke_rule: the always-run test variant at selfcheck_replicates = 2 (the only key a test may override) asserts that every never list holds in both replicates, that each world and scenario gives a token in expected for each subject it names in at least one of the two replicates, and that two runs give byte-identical blocks; it does not apply the predicate's minimums
selfcheck_stamp_rule: written by the runner's --selfcheck command with passed, config_hash, pipeline_hash, source_hashes, packages (the fields of provenance.packages, machine included) and the selfcheck block; committed beside the protocol in a commit of its own after the pipeline commit and before the run; phase 1 refuses unless it is tracked at HEAD, its working LF hash equals that of git show HEAD:<path>, passed is true, its three hashes equal the current ones and its packages equal the current ones (a stamp made under other packages or on another machine is replaced by a new --selfcheck stamp before the run); phase 3 recomputes the block and stops unless it equals the stamp's block

generator_sanity_rules.latent_value_rate: a player's latent shot rate times the mean of the truth model's probability over shots drawn at his distance scale
generator_sanity_rules.latent_rate_value_correlation: Pearson correlation of latent shot rate and latent value rate over the generator's population of player draws
generator_sanity_rules.latent_team_variance_share: var over teams of opp_half_duel_rate x (1 - team unattributed probability), divided by itself plus the expected Poisson variance per 90 of a regular's season value of opp_half_defensive_actions
generator_sanity_rules.draws: EFFECT's latent_rate_value_correlation is computed over synthetic_generator_sanity_players player draws (positions DF, MD, FW in turn), each with his shot-rate multiplier and distance scale drawn as 8.1 draws them and synthetic_generator_sanity_shots_per_player shots drawn at his distance scale by the shot rule of 8.1 (coordinates rounded by synthetic_shot_coordinate_rule, the truth model's probability computed from the rounded coordinates), all from the generator-sanity stream of selfcheck_seed_rule: first every player's multiplier, then every player's distance scale, then each player's shots in player order; NUISANCE's latent_team_variance_share is computed from the config's parameters and needs no draw

synthetic_instrument_match_rule: each shot's game_id drawn uniformly from the league's synthetic_instrument_matches_per_league match ids
synthetic_shot_coordinate_rule: from distance d and lateral offset c (c <= d by construction): X = sqrt(d^2 - c^2), start_x = 1 - X / pitch_length_m, start_y = 0.5 - c / pitch_width_m on the attacker's left (y = 0 is the attacker's left) and 0.5 + c / pitch_width_m on his right, both rounded to synthetic_coordinate_decimals; every feature, the truth model's included, is computed from the rounded coordinates
synthetic_logit_median_rule: TOO_SHARP and SLOPE_SHIFT take the median of the truth logit over the league's own synthetic shots, after rounding
synthetic_instrument_frame_rule: scenario shot frames carry SHOT_COLUMNS: event_id 1..n in draw order within the league, game_id by synthetic_instrument_match_rule, team_id 1 and player_id 1 on every row (the instrument reads neither), counter_attack false, head_or_body by synthetic_head_or_body_probability, goal from the scenario's truth

power_planning.rule: per league P(half_low >= threshold) = Phi(sqrt(n - 2 - g) * (atanh(rho) - atanh(t)) - interval_z), rho = R / (2 - R), t = threshold / (2 - threshold), g = 3; P(at least four of five) = p^5 + 5 p^4 (1 - p); the same true within-position reliability R in every league; no redundancy

selfcheck_feasibility.by: the reviser of 14 October 2026, event-level throwaway script on synthetic numbers only, the generator, gauntlet, rule and instrument gates of this config as they then stood, with 2000 bootstrap replicates; 40 replicates per world and scenario, seeds by selfcheck_seed_rule from replicate 0; not this exact generator and estimator: which reading of the lognormal multiplier the script used is not recorded (every multiplier is now exp(N(-s^2/2, s)), second audit 4-11), and the IRLS was revised after it (second audit 2-1, coefficients agreeing to about 1e-9); the third audit's synthetic check of both multiplier readings left every EFFECT candidate's smallest league lower bound far above reliability_number (third_audit_multiplier_check), and the binding check is the pipeline's own self-check on the frozen generator

third_audit_multiplier_check.method: a simplified player-level simulation of the position-centred split-half bound (Poisson counts per player-match), not the event-level generator; rerun by the reviser of the third audit

selfcheck_feasibility.minimum_set_from: audit revision of 18 October 2026: with miss rate (observed misses + 1) / 40 per subject, 9 of 12 passes with 0.9998 at one miss in 40 (fifteen subjects), 0.9978 at two (LEVEL_SHIFT), and 8 of 12 with 0.9988 at three (PLANTED, ACCEPTED), so all seventeen minimum conditions hold together with 0.9941 if independent (the earlier minimums, 10, 10 and 9 of 12, gave 0.9296); never lists hold only tokens that would classify a planted truth as its opposite, none of which occurred in any simulated replicate, and this arithmetic does not bound them

planning_figures.rule: figures the protocol states in prose as planning figures, with their basis; none gates anything
planning_figures.italy_o_e_basis: Italy's disclosed goal rate 9.69% over the unweighted mean 10.80% of the other four leagues' (section 2)
planning_figures.r3_basis: the draft's derived 0.04 understated it: 0.053 on the auditor's synthetic PLANTED scenario, 12 replicates x 5 leagues
planning_figures.r4_basis: spread of the pooled out-of-league ratio over 12 replicates per scenario, ranges over the PLANTED, LEVEL_SHIFT and SLOPE_SHIFT scenarios, from the second audit's literal implementation of PIPELINE 5 (synthetic numbers only), checked by the reviser on PLANTED with M1 (footed 0.0001, head-or-body 0.0004, the three distance bands 0.009, 0.010 and 0.037); the footed and head-or-body ratios are 1 by construction up to second-order terms under leave-one-league-out, so their spread is no standard error of a test; the earlier range of 0.016 to 0.043 described no statistic of R4

shot_volume.reason: A published year-to-year correlation of about 0.66 for strikers; the raw correlation with mean pitch position is the likeliest closure if it fails.

shot_location_value.reason: The identity value = volume x mean value: the sum is about 1.5 times noisier than the count and the count dominates its variance.

box_shot_share.reason: 66 to 88 players per league in the share set; no published figure exists.

opp_half_defensive_actions.reason: Team instruction is context here; team is expected to explain a large share of its variance in the reported joint audit, which does not gate.

predictions_matched_rule: matched is true when the subject's token equals the predicted token; reasons are not scored; a miss changes nothing
interpretation_limits: Exploratory: the data were seen before this protocol was written. Repeatability within one season among players of the same broad position is not validity and not decision use, and no E-09 statistic is shown beside players in this release.

interpretation_language.redundant_location_value_against_volume: Weighting shots by a location-only conversion model did not separate players that counting shots does not, in the leagues where the frozen rule closed it against open-play shot volume, in this corpus.
interpretation_language.redundant_other: The statistic was a near-copy of the named declared baseline statistic in the leagues where the frozen rule closed it against that statistic, in this corpus.
interpretation_language.redundant_rule: applied league by league to every league closed as REDUNDANT: redundant_location_value_against_volume for a league of shot_location_value whose closest_baselines include shot_volume; redundant_other, naming the column of closest_baselines, for every other league closed as REDUNDANT, of any candidate; a candidate closed in several leagues may carry both sentences, each limited to its own leagues
interpretation_language.instrument_not_accepted: This location-only model did not meet its frozen out-of-league criteria.
interpretation_language.instrument_not_accepted_rule: instrument_not_accepted for the instrument token NOT_ESTABLISHED only; an INCONCLUSIVE instrument was not judged, and analysis.md uses the statement of registry_outcomes.instrument.INCONCLUSIVE for it; league_not_computed_reasons.instrument_not_accepted is a code that covers both tokens
interpretation_language.established: Repeatable within a season among players of the same broad position, and, in the leagues where it passed, not a copy of the declared baselines.

reuse_disclosure: prospective analysis plan on reused historical data; see preregistration.md section 2
